name: rbi_get_forex_reserves
description:
India's foreign exchange reserves, from the Reserve Bank of India's DBIE endpoint (rbi.org.in/Scripts/api/dbie, no API key).
Returns: series_code, label, description, unit, frequency, observation_count and observations (date, value) as the endpoint orders them.
Inputs (none required): start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, passed through as fromDate and toDate); recent_periods (1-100; default 10; keeps the last N observations, only when no date is given).
For rupee exchange rates use rbi_get_exchange_rate; for reserves of other countries imf_get_ifs_data with international_reserves.
Example: {"recent_periods": 12}
